newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen holding up in buyerless market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen holding up in buyerless market.

text.p: Danish share prices edged up in early trade on Thursday in a lethargic market suffering from a dearth of buyers and expected to hold current levels.
"The market was rather tired again yesterday and there was a considerable distance between buyers. This situation could well continue today with minimal changes to the index," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.22 point to 170.49 at 0740 GMT, having closed 0.11 point down on Wednesday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
